title: Normalized scalar coordinates on zeroth unit-module cohomology
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $X$ a scheme over $k$ with structure morphism $f$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base], and suppose $k\to\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ is bijective. Use the restricted-scalar cohomology [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. Let $u_X\in H_k^0(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be the image of the section $1$ under the canonical map from global sections to zeroth right-derived global sections [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology]. There exists a $k$-linear equivalence $d:H_k^0(X,\mathcal O_X)\simeq k$ such that $d^{-1}(r)=r u_X$ for every $r\in k$. The class $u_X$ is constructed using the named natural transformation to the zeroth right derived functor, not chosen from an existence theorem.

proof.text: Module-sheaf evaluation at the terminal open preserves finite limits by Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Sheaf.Limits. Enough injectives gives the canonical rightDerivedZeroIsoSelf from zeroth derived evaluation to evaluation.

Restrict this isomorphism along the structure ring map and compose with the inverse of the linear equivalence of sections induced by its bijectivity. Its inverse sends r to the image of the section scalarMap(r). By linearity and scalarMap(1)=1 this is r times the explicitly constructed class of 1.

theorem scalar_unit_cohomology_coordinates {k : Type u} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (h : Function.Bijective (scalarMap f ⊤)) :
    ∃ d : scalarCohomology f (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) 0 ≃ₗ[k] k,
      ∀ r : k, d.symm r = r • scalarUnitCohomologyClass f
